parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue of `sphinx-quickstart` not exiting when pressing Enter, but it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the path prompt.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the path prompt to allow empty input, which might not be the intended behavior for all users. It also introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the function `ask_user` in a way that affects other prompts.
